verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Lovable letting users issue scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an agent. The Lovable MCP server (docs-37) lets agents act on projects, but no credential scoping is documented. The 'permissions, and access' configuration (docs-8) applies to a user's published app exposed as an MCP server, and 'granular access controls' (docs-46) is about enterprise workspace access. Both are adjacent features, not scoped agent credentials, and no OpenAPI spec was found (probe-2).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
